rq-rw-04.front: Does crisp mean fresh on a cold still morning?
rq-rw-04.back: Not always; cold still air keeps tracks crisp for days (65%).

rq-rw-06.back: Mixed: little change, small effects, or a drop then rebound (55 to 65%).

An Oklahoma GPS study over 7 years found little change with wind speed, 60 percent. A South Carolina GPS thesis found small effects in some seasons and hours, 65 percent. An older South Texas radio collar study from the 1980s found a drop at 24 to 31 kilometres an hour and a rebound above 32, 55 percent. The results are mixed. rq-rw-07.back: Moved less during storms (80%); bucks less than does in rain (65%).
